title: Choose the visual world for DevTalk
question: The roll assigned The Program. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Everything your brief pinned (dev-tool calm, dark default, diffs, sidebar, Ctrl+K) holds in every card.

options.label: The Program
options.lineage: meetup and conference programs, track colours, the speaker's timing lights
options.thesis: Your practice day set as a conference program: sessions on tracks, a timekeeper for every turn.
options.viewport: Sidebar left; the main column is today's program as a timetable: warm-up review, one challenge on its track, an optional second; the next session leads with Start.
options.risk: Drifts into event-app kitsch (lanyards, badges, confetti) if the world reaches past type, palette, rhythm and the timing lights.

raised.raise: Focus: while you write, the program dims and only the session in hand stays lit.
One family: a single hyperlegible sans carries headings, labels and body; its mono sibling only for diffs and timers; structure from 1px rules, not shadowed cards.
Registration: an expression card keeps the same layout and scale in Feedback, Review and a challenge; only its stage strip changes.
Marks over numbers: how often a mistake recurs is drawn as a row of marks, so Progress never becomes a number dashboard.
Tonal ramp: every neutral comes from one 11-step ramp; no ad-hoc greys.

options.label: Galley Proof
options.lineage: a copy editor's galley marked in non-repro blue pencil
options.thesis: Every answer is a galley; the coach marks it in blue pencil, the way an editor helps rather than grades.
options.viewport: Sidebar left; your last answer set as a galley with the coach's marks in the margin, and the next galley waiting to be written.
options.risk: The most familiar card here: a calm dark editor with one blue accent is where most runs for a writing tool land.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: Only the next decision, signed large: one band tells you what to do now.
options.viewport: Sidebar left; one yellow band across the top names the single next step with its time; everything below is quiet.
options.case: Holds product clarity (one next step is a product principle) but loses audience identification: airports are not a developer's world.
options.risk: Saturated yellow tires a reading session unless it stays confined to the single next-step band.

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.thesis: Challenges as rows of tiles; the focused one grows.
options.viewport: Rows of challenge tiles by category.
options.case: Browsing a catalog fights 'one next step', and developers do not read practice as entertainment.
options.kept: Focus discipline: the item in hand grows, everything else gets out of the way.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Registration furniture and one grotesque on near-white stock.
options.viewport: A white sheet with registered plates.
options.case: Light, gallery-like and decorative where the brief pins a dark working tool.
options.risk: Reads as a portfolio, not a tool.
options.kept: One family carries everything; structure from 1px hairlines.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: An expression shown through its learning stages at one fixed scale.
options.viewport: Expression plates from new to mastered.
options.case: Cream and botanical; developers do not identify with it.
options.kept: Registration: the same element keeps the same scale wherever it appears.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Mistakes as stars whose size is their frequency.
options.case: Poetic, but the task is writing, not exploring a chart.
options.kept: Marks carry quantity so type does not have to shout numbers.

options.label: Darkroom Zone Sheets
options.thesis: Stacked translucent sheets over an eleven-step zone ramp.
options.case: Hatching and sliding sheets obscure a simple write-and-review task.
options.risk: Costume of a craft the audience does not practise.
options.kept: One strict tonal ramp supplies every neutral.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark developer tool in the familiar mould, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, a header, a primary card for the next challenge, stats beneath.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other dark dev tool by design.
